description: This file provides a wrapper around GLib functions, including factory methods for creating GLib wrapper instances, and utility functions for GLib object manipulation and string operations. It also implements a singleton pattern for managing GLib wrapper instances within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

classes.name: GlibWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing static methods for GLib object and string operations.

classes.name: GlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing singleton pattern for creating and managing instances of IGlibWrapper.

classes.name: IGlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: Interface for the GLib wrapper factory.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton instance of IGlibWrapperFactory, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getGlibWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton instance of IGlibWrapper, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: gObjectSet
methods.description: Sets properties on a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Gets properties from a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectClassFindProperty
methods.description: Finds a property in a GObjectClass by name.

methods.name: gStrdupPrintf
methods.description: Creates a formatted string using g_strdup_vprintf.

methods.name: gStrHasPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specified prefix.
